'''Uniqueness''' is printed as dots (•) or a diamond (◊) in a card title.

* '''Unique (•)''' — a player may not have two copies of that card (or another version of the same [[Persona|persona]]) on table at once.
* '''Restricted (••, •••, …)''' — a player may have that many copies on table.
* '''Unrestricted''' — no title dots; any number may be on table.
* '''◊ (diamond)''' — a deployment restriction used on some later cards (for example the [[Trade Federation Droid Control Ship]]). A ◊ starship may not deploy or move to a location where another copy of that ◊ starship already exists.
